INSERT INTO wx_message_history ( id, user_id, app_id, wxid, msg_id, new_msg_id, from_wxid, to_wxid, msg_type, content, msg_time, raw_data, archive_time ) SELECT id, user_id, app_id, wxid, msg_id, new_msg_id, from_wxid, to_wxid, msg_type, content, msg_time, raw_data, NOW() FROM wx_message WHERE msg_time < #{beforeTime}
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), app_id = VALUES(app_id), wxid = VALUES(wxid), msg_id = VALUES(msg_id), new_msg_id = VALUES(new_msg_id), from_wxid = VALUES(from_wxid), to_wxid = VALUES(to_wxid), msg_type = VALUES(msg_type), content = VALUES(content), msg_time = VALUES(msg_time), raw_data = VALUES(raw_data), archive_time = NOW()
